note: Defect T-602 diagnosis (MOD_PLAN.md section 7): STRATA_MMVQ_IL_PLAIN=1 (spec 85) gave 'verify: layer 0 never rang (an illegal memory access was encountered)'. On gfx1100 the plain-column table is all 0, so the plain path falls back to native_mmvq; the new part that runs is the HC read writing the interleaved copy (fused_gr.cu gr_q8_tail, q8_il) and, with q8_il set, the RDNA read (STRATA_GR_RDNA) is bypassed for launch_q8 / the generic read. One arm per spec. Serialized launches name the faulting kernel; STRATA_MMVQ_IL_CHECK=1 compares the read's copy with native_q8_1_interleave. Diagnostic: read the arm's .out file.
